user.title: Cozmo
user.description: Cozmo is its own Wi-Fi access point. Point this at the companion, then enter the adapter that should join Cozmo, plus the SSID and password printed on the lift. That adapter must not be your normal network. One adapter links one robot.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Cozmo companion. Is it running and reachable from Home Assistant?

abort.already_configured: This companion URL is already configured
abort.cannot_connect: The Cozmo companion is not reachable yet. Is it started?

init.title: Cozmo options
init.description: Wi-Fi adapter, SSID, and password are enough for this robot. Change the companion URL only when this Cozmo lives on another host.

drive.name: Drive wheels
drive.description: Drive Cozmo's wheels (pycozmo Client.drive_wheels). Speeds are mm/s, max 200.

left_speed.name: Left wheel
left_speed.description: Left wheel speed in mm/s (negative is reverse)

right_speed.name: Right wheel
right_speed.description: Right wheel speed in mm/s (negative is reverse)

play_anim.name: Play animation
play_anim.description: Play a Cozmo animation clip (requires pycozmo_resources.py download on the companion).

set_face.name: Set face
set_face.description: Show a procedural face from pycozmo.expressions.

expression.name: Expression
expression.description: One of the pycozmo.expressions names (happiness, sadness, …)

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stop motors and cancel the current animation.

play_audio.name: Play audio
play_audio.description: Download a WAV/MP3 URL and play it on Cozmo (22 kHz 16-bit mono after transcode). This is the TTS hook — pycozmo has no text-to-speech.

media_url.name: Media URL
media_url.description: HTTP URL of a WAV or MP3 file

set_head.name: Set head angle
set_head.description: Set head angle in degrees (−25 to 44.5).

play.name: Play
play.description: Play a named Cozmo reaction (hello, dance, sleep, and the other built-in moods).

name.name: Reaction
name.description: hello, happy, curious, celebrate, dance, bored, blink, pounce, sleep, or wake

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: Local espeak-ng TTS on the companion (PyCozmo has no off-board speech). Install espeak-ng on the companion host.

phrase_id.name: Phrase id
phrase_id.description: Catalog id such as hello, yay, goodbye

wifi_join.name: Join Cozmo Wi-Fi
wifi_join.description: Ask the companion to associate the USB dongle with Cozmo's AP (never-default NM profile). Ethernet stays on the LAN.

ssid.name: SSID
ssid.description: Override SSID (default: the one stored in the config entry)
